8.en: Every Imperial institution exudes fear as a measure of control and authority, some more underhanded than others. The @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.HlxK2pbpx2Uio6bU]{Imperial Fleet}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.6Yav4onpokz5e5jg]{Astra Militarum}, and Adeptus Astartes wield the fear of raw military might. The @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.cvpsLwcsXf4myIpK]{Adeptus Administratum} brandishes regulations, procedures, and weaponised bureaucracy to oppress those outside their inner circles. The @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.HURMpEU0Nnc93Ocv]{Adeptus Ministorum} and @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.nYfLVXh10BKR47Kj]{Adeptus Mechcanicus} preach fears of countless unknowns and depravities, offering a lonely beacon of purity or righteousness as succour. In their grim ways, the Imperium itself is a bastion built upon terror.

12.en: Yet all of them pale compared to the visceral fear exuded by the Inquisition — its agents are everywhere and nowhere, all-seeing and all-knowing, implacably ruthless and utterly remorseless. It is this pervasive, insidious construct of lurking dread that you, the GM, have the pleasure and challenge of bringing to life in all its dark and sinister glory.

16.en: In running an Inquisition-focused adventure, a GM is freed from many of the usual constraints wrought by the other institutions of the Imperium. While other organisations hold a stiff bureaucratic chain of command with policies and procedures to go with it, these are quickly subordinated to the immediate needs of Inquisitors.

20.en: There are simply too many threats across too much space which must be dealt with immediately — and if bureaucracy must be set aside to do so, so be it. Inquisitors have almost unlimited authority for good reason: they are fighting an unending war to save Humanity’s soul.

24.en: Inquisitors and their acolytes are essentially free to go anywhere, to compel testimony from anyone, to bring any person under scrutiny for potentially consorting with dangerous xenos or vile forces of Chaos. This gives you far more freedom to develop adventures that will take the characters into places they would not usually get to go: the heart of an Adeptus Militarum bastion or an Imperial Fleet voidship, the innermost sanctum of an Ecclesiarchy cathedrum, the fume-filled depths of an Adeptus Mechanicus forge world, or the gleaming spires housing the nobility atop a hive.

28.en: Moreover, since the role of Inquisitors is to find and destroy the lurking threats chewing at the inner stability of the Imperium, you are free to confront the characters with nearly any manner of enemy, from a vicious Drukhari raid erupting from a Webway portal to a sanity-blasting incursion of vile daemons from the Warp. Inquisition adventures allow you and the players to explore the Imperium from its most glistening heights to its foulest depths — and confront the myriad wonders and terrors they will find there.
